text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "unease" in Mihono Bourbon's chest 
persists. Her condition falters, her lap 
times fall into disarray... Until finally, 
she collapses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While resting, Mihono Bourbon runs into 
Rice Shower training fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to beat Mihono 
Bourbon, the one she admired. Thinking 
that way helped banish her timidity and 
gave her the strength to do her best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon realized that she, too, had 
such emotions... That the "fluttering" 
inside her was actually the desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the moment she realized what that 
"unease" truly was, she bounced right back 
into top shape in no time.
